```artifact
/* Finite State Machine for Logging Requirements (U21_Logging) */

States:
  1. IDLE
  2. RECORDING
  3. COMPLETED

Events:
  - CONFIRM_VENTILATION_SETTINGS
  - CHANGE_RTC
  - REQUEST_LOG
  - MEMORY_FULL

Transitions:
  - IDLE → RECORDING
    Guard: CONFIRM_VENTILATION_SETTINGS (True)
  - RECORDING → COMPLETED
    Guard: (All ventilation settings confirmed) AND (Date & Timestamp recorded) AND (RTC change logged) (True)
  - COMPLETED → IDLE
    Guard: REQUEST_LOG (True)
  - RECORDING → IDLE
    Guard: MEMORY_FULL (False)

Actions:
  - In RECORDING state:
    - Log confirmed ventilation settings
    - Record current date and timestamp
    - Log changes to the system's real-time clock (Current Date/Time followed by new Date/Time)
```

```json
[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Confirm ventilation settings and log event",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-25"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["System in IDLE state"],
    "inputs": {
      "name": "CONFIRM_VENTILATION_SETTINGS",
      "value": "true"
    },
    "steps": [
      "Trigger CONFIRM_VENTILATION_SETTINGS event",
      "System transitions to RECORDING state",
      "Log confirmed ventilation settings to non-volatile memory"
    ],
    "expected": [
      "Event log contains confirmed ventilation settings"
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-002",
    "title": "Record date and timestamp in the event log",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-29"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["System in RECORDING state"],
    "inputs": {
      "name": "REQUEST_LOG",
      "value": "true"
    },
    "steps": [
      "Trigger REQUEST_LOG event",
      "System transitions to COMPLETED state",
      "Record current date and timestamp in the event log"
    ],
    "expected": [
      "Event log includes a date and timestamp"
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-003",
    "title": "Log changes to the system's real-time clock",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-30"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["System in RECORDING state"],
    "inputs": {
      "name": "CHANGE_RTC",
      "value": "true"
    },
    "steps": [
      "Trigger CHANGE_RTC event",
      "System logs Current Date/Time followed by new Date/Time in the event log"
    ],
    "expected": [
      "Event log includes changes to the system's real-time clock"
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-004",
    "title": "Negative path: Attempt to log when memory is full",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-23"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["System in RECORDING state", "Memory is full"],
    "inputs": {
      "name": "CONFIRM_VENTILATION_SETTINGS",
      "value": "true"
    },
    "steps": [
      "Trigger CONFIRM_VENTILATION_SETTINGS event",
      "System checks MEMORY_FULL guard (False)",
      "System transitions to IDLE state without logging"
    ],
    "expected": [
      "No new log entry is created; system remains in IDLE state"
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-005",
    "title": "Boundary value: Log at the earliest possible timestamp",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-29"],
    "kind": "boundary",
    "preconditions": ["System in RECORDING state"],
    "inputs": {
      "name": "REQUEST_LOG",
      "value": "true"
    },
    "steps": [
      "Trigger REQUEST_LOG event at earliest possible timestamp",
      "System records date and timestamp in the event log"
    ],
    "expected": [
      "Event log includes the earliest possible date and timestamp"
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-006",
    "title": "Boundary value: Log at the latest possible timestamp",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-29"],
    "kind": "boundary",
    "preconditions": ["System in RECORDING state"],
    "inputs": {
      "name": "REQUEST_LOG",
      "value": "true"
    },
    "steps": [
      "Trigger REQUEST_LOG event at latest possible timestamp",
      "System records date and timestamp in the event log"
    ],
    "expected": [
      "Event log includes the latest possible date and timestamp"
    ]
  }
]
```
